dedupe_keys.name: juba shabelle river floods series of 14 event data sets

description: Juba Shabelle River Floods (series of 14 event data sets) is a series of data sets listed in SODMA open data portal (Somalia and Greater Horn of Africa disaster risk data), a disaster risk data portal, published or maintained by SWALIM. This data was produced through visual interpretation of Sentinel 2 satellite images acquired between 1st May - 31st August 2021.Additionally, we complemented the data with Kompsat 5 satellite images images for the month of May 2021. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal lists 14 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher SWALIM. Its tags are 2021, floods, gu, juba, river. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, PNG. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sodma-somalia-disaster-risk-data-portal.
